name: 夕阳再现-炎龙20141231
english_name: Sunset Reappears: Fire Dragon Edition (2014-12-31 Build)
english_description: A more heavily modified, later-stage build within the Sunset Reappears family: its custom wizard rank ladder runs all the way up to "(boss)"/"(ceo)", character creation adds an extra step for choosing one of eleven schools of magic after stat allocation, and it supports multiple client protocols (ZMud/ToMud).
